rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 10 of 40 hours APA- or NASP-approved; rest via courses approved by any state psychology association, first-time teaching of a psychology course (max 20), graduate psychology course (max 20), presentations (max 20), board/association service (max 20), community mental-health board service (max 10), publications (max 10), professional books (max 5)
rules.notes: Ch. 18 (eff. 10/02/2025): 40 h per 2 years incl. 3 h ethics + 3 h Risk Assessment (harm to self/others, inability to self-care); APA/NASP approval not needed for these. Licenses expire June 30 yearly. Board policy 11/7/2025: 2026/2027 CE renewals may still use old rule (30 h in 48 months).
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Board of Psychology Rules, Chapter 18 (Continuing Education), Section 2; Chapter 8, Sections 2-3
rules.alternatives: Becoming ABPP board certified satisfies the full 40-hour requirement (usable once while licensed in Wyoming).
rules.audit_note: Licensee keeps documentation from the CE sponsor and submits it to the Board on request; must justify how hours relate to psychology practice.
